resources.string: A layered paper-cutout landscape that scrolls across your screen, with the sun and moon following the time of day.
The sun and moon move based on your device\'s clock (or your location, if enabled)
Calculate precise sunrise and sunset times based on your area
PaperScrape is an open-source live wallpaper inspired by classic "paper cutout" animated backgrounds. Source code available on GitHub.
Real current conditions replace each theme\'s manual rain/snow/cloud settings automatically, refreshed hourly. While on, this theme\'s own Clouds/Precipitation screens switch to read-only.
Pick a location above first - GPS, Network or Custom - so it knows where to check the weather for.
Location unavailable — showing this theme\'s own weather instead.
When on, PaperScrape asks GitHub for a newer release each time you open these settings, and once a day while the wallpaper is on screen. Off by default; the button below always works.
Puts a quiet notification in the shade when a newer release appears. No sound and no pop-up. Only while PaperScrape is your wallpaper and on screen; it checks at most once a day.
Turn \"Check for updates automatically\" on first - this is how PaperScrape tells you what that check found. Your choice here is kept until then.
Notifications are switched off for PaperScrape in your phone\'s settings, so nothing would appear.
A quiet note when a newer release of PaperScrape is out. At most one per version, no sound, and never more than once a day.
You have v%1$s. Tap to see what\'s new.
